settings.title: A dream come true
settings.body: I’m a West Ham fan and it was my dream to get this cup. The size and detail are spot on. I will treasure it.

settings.name: James T.
settings.title: Incredible detail for a 1:1 replica
settings.body: Ordered this as a surprise for my dad, a lifelong football fan. The size and finish are stunning, and engraving our family name on it made it really personal. It now has pride of place in his study.

settings.name: Daniel O.
settings.title: Exactly like the trophy on TV
settings.body: I was nervous ordering something this big online, but it arrived perfectly packed and looks identical to the cup I've seen lifted on TV. Communication throughout was excellent.

settings.hero_desc: A premium 1:50 scale architectural model of a residential tower with warm LED-lit floors, streetscape and landscaping, presented on a branded base. The ideal sales-gallery centrepiece for a property launch.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your tower, lighting, landscaping and branded base
settings.s1_body: We build your residential tower as a detailed scale model, lit from within so every floor glows warmly. Set on a branded base with streetscape and landscaping, it gives buyers and investors a tangible sense of the finished building - the centrepiece your sales gallery needs to turn interest into deposits.
settings.case_body: Built for El Prima residential launch, this lit tower model became the focal point of the sales gallery - buyers could see the finished building glowing, helping them commit before a single floor was built.
settings.case_quote: Buyers are drawn straight to it. The lit model has become central to how we sell the project.
settings.prov_p: Buyers commit to what they can see. A lit, detailed tower model lets them experience the finished building today - and reach for the deposit.
